questions.question: Use focus_lines in order to know Which country shows the most dramatic improvement in male survival rate to age 65 from 1960 to 2021?

answer.value: China demonstrates the most dramatic improvement with a total increase of 66.38% from 15.89% in 1960 to 82.27% in 2021, representing an average annual increase of 1.09%

key_insights: China had the lowest starting survival rate in 1960 at 15.89%
China achieved the highest total increase of 66.38%
China shows the fastest average annual growth rate of 1.09% per year

reasoning.reasoning: Use focus_lines to highlight China and observe its dramatic improvement in male survival rate to age 65 over 61-year period
